findings.detail: Tool "hubvibe_lead_qualify" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Lead qualification in one call from a business website, fetched once by plain HTTP (no browser): SEO and security-header findings, static accessibility signals (images without alt, unlabelled fields, empty links), platform and marketing tags (WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Google Analytics, Tag Manager, G" → after: "Assess an existing business website supplied by the caller (not lead discovery). One plain HTTP fetch (no browser) produces SEO and security-header findings, static accessibility signals, platform and marketing tags, domain mail setup (MX, SPF, DMARC), company profile, and a 0-100 website opportunit"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
